items.name: first_block_is_identity
items.source:
fn first_block_is_identity(blocks: &[Value]) -> bool {
    blocks
        .first()
        .and_then(|block| block.get("text"))
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .is_some_and(|text| text.starts_with(CLAUDE_CODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT))
}
